description: This Java class 'PropFindHelper' provides helper methods for handling WebDAV PROPFIND requests and responses, including creating property elements, retrieving property lists from XML documents, and checking request types.

classes.name: PropFindHelper
classes.description: Helper class for WebDAV PROPFIND request/response processing, extending ResponseHelper.

methods.name: createPropElement
methods.description: Creates a 'prop' XML element containing a list of property elements.

methods.name: createPropStatElement
methods.description: Creates a 'propstat' XML element with a property and status.

methods.name: getFindPropsList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of property elements from the request XML document based on namespace.

methods.name: isAllProp
methods.description: Checks if the request is for all properties ('allprop').

methods.name: isPropName
methods.description: Checks if the request is for property names ('propname').
